topic: How to use AI to turn your Google reviews into a lead generation machine
findings: 81% of consumers use Google specifically to read reviews when evaluating a local business
Businesses that rank in the top 3 local search positions average 47 Google reviews, vs. only 38 for positions 7-10
Businesses that increase their average rating by one full star see up to a 44% improvement in conversion likelihood
80% of local searches on Google Maps lead to a physical visit within 24 hours
